host.description: IEC 104 server hostname or IP address

commonAddress.description: Common Address of ASDU (CA). Identifies the target station.

originatorAddress.description: Originator address (OA). Identifies the originating station.

readTimeoutMs.description: Read/response timeout in milliseconds (t1 APDU timeout)

giOnConnect.description: Automatically send General Interrogation (GI) after STARTDT handshake

maxUnack.description: Maximum unacknowledged I-frames before sending S-frame (k parameter)

t1Ms.description: APDU timeout t1 in milliseconds. Max time to wait for an APDU response.

t2Ms.description: S-frame timeout t2 in milliseconds. Max time before sending S-frame ack.

t3Ms.description: Test frame timeout t3 in milliseconds. Idle time before sending TESTFR.

connectionSummary: Connects to an IEC 104 server via TCP transport. Performs STARTDT handshake to activate the data transfer. Supports General Interrogation (GI), Counter Interrogation, Clock Synchronization, and command sending (single/double/setpoint). Full ASDU parsing for all standard Type Identifications including single-point, double-point, measured values, and time-tagged variants.
connectionSteps: Set the target IEC 104 server host and TCP port (default: 2404).
Engine sends STARTDT act U-frame and waits for STARTDT con from the server.
With the data transfer activated, General Interrogation, Counter Interrogation, and command operations are available via capability actions.
All I-format frames are parsed as ASDUs with full Type Identification decoding.
On disconnect, the session is cleanly torn down.
readBehavior: Read waits for the next received I-format frame and returns the raw APDU bytes. The frame is automatically decoded with ASDU parsing for display.
writeBehavior: Write sends raw bytes as an I-format frame with proper sequence number management.
